title: 9-year-old boy with fever
arrival: A 9-year-old boy is brought in by his father for three days of fever, with worsening cough and difficulty breathing.
keyCriterion: Red — Airway & breathing: respiratory distress (chest indrawing)
feedbackWhy: Chest indrawing indicates accessory muscle use and respiratory distress.

airway_red.text: His chest draws inward when he breathes.

circulation_red.text: Strong pulse. Warm extremities. Capillary refill 2 seconds.

other_red.text: No trauma, poisoning, threatened limb or surgical diagnosis. Fever for three days.

airway_yellow.text: No swelling of the mouth, throat or neck. No stridor.

circulation_yellow.text: Drinking normally. No vomiting, diarrhoea or dehydration.

disability_yellow.text: Alert. Not irritable. Not in severe pain.
